title: LinkedIn Post Detail
description: Returns the body, author, reaction count and comment count of a public LinkedIn post, from its URL, activity id or urn. Reads the logged-out public page and the schema.org block LinkedIn embeds in it, so no account, cookie or login is involved. Posts that are private, deleted or login-walled report themselves as unavailable rather than returning an empty shell.

post_urls.description: Post URLs, activity ids, or urn:li:activity urns.
